bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4b06a39ebdb8a99d5544b27c8a52f33ad8e42440"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
printf 'HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
for service in debug-ai sandbox-runner; do
  cid="$(docker compose ps --quiet "$service")"
  test -n "$cid"
  docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}} {{.State.Status}} {{.Image}} {{.Created}}' "$cid"
done
docker compose images --format json
printf 'BUILD_PROCESS_COUNT='
ps -eo comm= | awk '$1=="docker-buildx" || $1=="docker-compose" {n++} END {print n+0}'
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 node -e 'console.log("ROLE_MODE="+process.env.DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE)'
printf 'HEALTH=%s\n' "$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health)"
printf 'READBACK_COMPLETE\n'
